DDL	CREATE table  desc_temp1 (key int COMMENT 'column_comment', val string) USING PARQUET
DDL	CREATE table  desc_temp2 (key int, val string) USING PARQUET
READ	DESC SELECT key, key + 1 as plusone FROM desc_temp1
READ	DESC QUERY SELECT * FROM desc_temp2
READ	DESC SELECT key, COUNT(*) as count FROM desc_temp1 group by key
READ	DESC SELECT 10.00D as col1
READ	DESC QUERY SELECT key FROM desc_temp1 UNION ALL select CAST(1 AS DOUBLE)
READ	DESC QUERY VALUES(1.00D, 'hello') as tab1(col1, col2)
READ	DESC QUERY FROM desc_temp1 a SELECT *
READ	DESC WITH s AS (SELECT 'hello' as col1) SELECT * FROM s
READ	DESCRIBE QUERY WITH s AS (SELECT * from desc_temp1) SELECT * FROM s
READ	DESCRIBE SELECT * FROM (FROM desc_temp2 select * select *)
PARSE_ERROR	DESCRIBE INSERT INTO desc_temp1 values (1, 'val1')
PARSE_ERROR	DESCRIBE INSERT INTO desc_temp1 SELECT * FROM desc_temp2
PARSE_ERROR	DESCRIBE
READ	EXPLAIN DESC QUERY SELECT * FROM desc_temp2 WHERE key > 0
READ	EXPLAIN EXTENDED DESC WITH s AS (SELECT 'hello' as col1) SELECT * FROM s
DDL	DROP TABLE desc_temp1
DDL	DROP TABLE desc_temp2
